title: Frozen in Flow
description:
Hello, Sweeteas!
With hot weather spreading across the globe, I thought it would be a good idea to give you a little…freeze. A breath of fresh, arctic air. A way to disengage from your body and your mind. In simple terms, in this file I embed a trigger in your mind which freezes you in place both mentally and physically, leaving you wide open to suggestions.
This freeze trigger can be used in a few different ways. For one, it can be a sort of primer, freezing your mind and opening you up to other files, making you infinitely more suggestible without an ounce of resistance anywhere in your mind or body. Two, it can be used by a play-partner to freeze you in place so that they could play with you in whichever way they choose. Three, it can used to cool you down during a hot summer day. Finally, it can also be used give your mind a good, deep break from the world, with your mind and body frozen and unable to think, reason, or move.
You can read more about the file in the script, but there isn’t anything particularly risky or edgy, so I think you won’t need to be doing that.
Now go and have fun and freeze!
